title.narrative: North Macedonia Agriculture Modernization Project Safe Disposal of Animal ByProducts Activities Trust Fund

description.narrative: The specific objective of the Project supported by the Trust Fund is to improve competitiveness in targeted agricultural sub-sectors and strengthen agricultural public sector readiness for EU accession. To this endcomma the European Commission and the World Bank agreed to provide support to North Macedonia and co-finance the investment of a Safe Disposal of Animal By-Products system (ABP safe disposal system) through this Trust Fund. The operation falls under North Macedonia Agriculture Modernization (IBRD financing – Loan No. 9037 - MK) (the Project) and the EU supports Rural Development and Competitive Sustainable Agriculture project (EU Instrument for Pre-accession Assistance (IPA II) 2014-2020; bilateral agreement IPA 2019/041-263/06.02/MK/ARD. The Trust Fund will contribute to: - Construction of an ABP safe disposal system; - Procure supplies for ABP collection and transport; and - Operationalization of the ABP safe disposal system.
